name: 柔韧亲肤软抽纸包款
description: 软包抽取式纸巾，压花纹理柔韧不掉屑，餐桌客厅随手用

styleLock.backgroundSystem: coarse-spun linen table top #D6B97E against an ivory #F7F1E4 wall, one woven rattan basket at the frame edge as the fixed depth anchor in every shot
styleLock.lightingSystem: single directional soft key from the upper left at 4600K with gentle falloff to the lower right, soft-to-medium contact shadow directly beneath the pack, no hard speculars, calm quiet morning mood
styleLock.surfaceSystem: coarse-spun linen weave and one light raw-wood board as the only two table surfaces
styleLock.typography: one humanist geometric sans-serif family, centered headline above a hairline divider, no serif, no script, no decorative display faces
styleLock.iconSystem: hairline leaf-vein line icons in #9B6B3C, uniform 1.5pt stroke, carried inside thin circular badges
styleLock.presentationRules: stable centered placement, product scale identical across shots, eye-level or true overhead angles only, horizon kept level, pack always resting with a real contact shadow
noDrift: no brand name, logo, watermark or QR code
no layer count, sheet count, grammage or size numbers
no pulp source, cotton ratio or material-grade wording
no antibacterial, low-irritation, medical or certification claims
no price, discount, shipping or membership badges
no children biting or tearing paper, no tissue touching mouth or nose
no non-woven or towel texture substitution
styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: warm rustic home-living paper-goods commerce visual system; fixed palette of ivory #F7F1E4, warm sand gold #D6B97E, deep umber text #3A2C1E and one ochre brown #9B6B3C accent; warm 4600K; fixed background of coarse-spun linen table top with a woven rattan basket as depth anchor; single directional soft key from the upper left with gentle falloff and truthful contact shadows; one humanist geometric sans-serif family; centered headline over hairline dividers with soft-cornered modular infographic blocks; hairline leaf-vein line icons in #9B6B3C inside thin circular badges; stable centered product scale and placement; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 7 张源片（_sources/纸巾/panels/panel-01~07）提炼，归档 _sources/纸巾。panel-02/03 的商品卡与卖点块合并为一张痛点镜，panel-03/04/05 的镜像卖点合入对比镜与细节镜。品类判据：图为软包抽取式餐巾纸，属家居日用·纸品清洁（与文件夹名一致），非母婴。主体风格取自源页的木纹盖面纸盒、雏菊静物与浅底长条版式，改以暖沙金+象牙白+赭石棕落地。
